thread:
maria: Heads up — deploybot tried a canary for 1.12.3 and health checks tripped at ~30% traffic, it auto-rolled back to 1.12.2 and created a new tag `1.12.2+rb`. Is that expected?
liam: Hmm we usually avoid bumping semver just for rollbacks. +rb sounds new — who flipped that flag? :eyes:
sara: Deploybot message showed `auto_rollback=true` in the webhook, it then created the tag and pushed release notes.
deploy-bot: Deploy status: CANARY_FAILED -> AUTO_ROLLBACK. Reverted to 1.12.2 (commit abc123). Created tag `1.12.2+rb` and posted release note.
jordan: That `+rb` makes downstream pinning confusing. If platform teams pin to "~1.12.2" they might suddenly pick up that tag depending on resolution rules.
maria: Exactly — proposal: on auto-rollback, do NOT create a new semver. Instead attach machine-readable metadata to the existing release note for 1.12.2 indicating it was a rollback target from 1.12.3.
liam: Agreed. Quick proposal I can PR for deploybot behavior:
```
if auto_rollback:
  dont_bump_semver()
  annotate_release(existing_tag, metadata={"rollback_of": failed_tag, "reason": "canary_health"})
  add_label(existing_tag, "auto-rollback")
```
sara: That feels safer. Also add a human-friendly line so release notes still make sense: "Canary for 1.12.3 failed; traffic reverted to 1.12.2".
maria: For downstream automation we should standardize a meta block at the bottom of release notes, e.g.
```
---redwood-meta
rollback_of: 1.12.3
reason: canary_healthcheck
timestamp: 1759991234
---
```
liam: I'll draft the PR and link the deploybot changelog. Will also add a toggle in deploybot config: `create_patch_on_rollback: false` by default.
jordan: Please also update the pinning doc to call out how to treat +buildmeta or +rb tags. We should recommend pins to exact semver (no buildmeta) or use `>=` policies with care.
maria: Cool. liam assign review to me and sara; i'll also update the release notes template to include the meta block.
sara: Quick follow-up: do we want to retroactively re-tag the 1.12.2+rb entries created last week? That might break folks.
liam: Don't touch history for now — we'll stop the behavior going forward and add a short note in changelog explaining current tags.
maria: Thanks all. I'll file a docs task for the pinning guidance. :shipit:
